biggest_catch: Concrete worker pay and a $20 payout threshold are published, but there is no official statement of WHEN payouts are actually sent after you request one - no processing schedule, no payout day, no timing SLA.
catches: No official payout processing schedule: the $20 minimum is stated, but Translate.com publishes no payout day, frequency, or processing-time SLA.
Pay is per word/page, not per hour: post-machine-translation $0.025/word and document translation $0.02/word mean a 500-word order pays roughly $10-12.50 before fees.
Average order values ($10-$100 for document translation) are examples, not guarantees - actual orders vary with client demand.
Application requires passing Translate.com's translator tests before any paid work is offered.

c1.evidence: translate.com/translators: post-machine translation $0.025/word (avg $15-$20/order); copy edit $0.015/word (avg $10-$15/order); document translation $0.02/word (avg $10-$100/order); scanned files est. $10/page (avg $50-$400/order); presentations est. $15/page (avg $70-$500/order).

c2.evidence: Official page states a $20 payout threshold and methods (PayPal, Wise, Revolut, Payoneer, Paxum, AdvCash) but no processing schedule, payout day, or timing SLA.

c3.evidence: No upfront fee documented in official terms.

c4.evidence: Numeric per-word/per-page rates and $20 minimum are official, but concrete payout timing is missing.

eligibility: Bilingual fluency in a supported language pair; pass Translate.com's translator screening tests.
maximize: If Translate.com ever publishes a payout schedule, maximize by prioritizing scanned-file and presentation orders ($10-$15/page beats $0.02/word on dense pages), building a text-expander glossary for your top language pair, and batching similar-domain orders so terminology research pays off across multiple jobs.
notes: Strongest translation-platform pay disclosure found: official numeric per-word/per-page worker rates and a $20 payout threshold. Rejected solely because no official payout timing (processing schedule) is published.
payout_quote: Official worker rates: post-machine translation $0.025/word (average $15-$20/order); copy edit $0.015/word (average $10-$15/order); document translation $0.02/word (average $10-$100/order); scanned files estimated $10/page (average $50-$400/order); presentations estimated $15/page (average $70-$500/order). $20 minimum payout threshold via PayPal, Wise, Revolut, Payoneer, Paxum, or AdvCash.

s6.note: Fails only on published payout timing.

steps: Apply as a translator at translate.com/translators and select your language pair.
Claim translation, editing, or post-editing orders from the work queue.
Complete orders to the style guide and request payout once your balance reaches $20.
timing: Official page states a $20 minimum payout threshold and lists methods (PayPal, Wise, Revolut, Payoneer, Paxum, AdvCash), but publishes no payout processing schedule, payout day, or timing SLA - timing is not concrete.
